changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAssetTypeLog') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [integration].[ExecutionAssetTypeLog]( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeLog_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [ExecutionID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [SynchedAssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Section] [int] NOT NULL, [Action] [varchar](1) NOT NULL, [Log] [nvarchar](max) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeLog] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeLog_IntegrationExecutionAssetType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[ExecutionAssetTypeLog] WITH NOCHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeLog_IntegrationExecutionAssetType] FOREIGN KEY([ExecutionID], [SynchedAssetTypeID]) REFERENCES [integration].[ExecutionAssetType] ([ExecutionID], [SynchedAssetTypeID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [integration].[ExecutionAssetTypeLog] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeLog_IntegrationExecutionAssetType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeLog') BEGIN CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeLog] ON [integration].[ExecutionAssetTypeLog] ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [SynchedAssetTypeID] ASC, [Section] ASC ) END
